<<<HELPERS
>>>
<<<PROOF
by
  intro m N M hM hN hDuDv hDet
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hcontra
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ m.detJ * M - m.S * N := by omega
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by omega
  have hN2 : 0 ≤ N ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg N
  have h1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hDuDv hN2
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (m.detJ * M - m.S * N) * M := Int.mul_nonneg hdiff hM0
  have h_id : m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 + (m.detJ * M - m.S * N) * M := by
    rw [T02]
    grind
  omega
>>>
